notes.title: Greenhouse is in Beta
notes.content: [p]We're feature complete and deep in final testing. The game is nearly ready, but we’re taking the time to polish every detail and make sure the game is at its best at launch.[/p][p]If you've played the demo, leaving a review helps push us closer to release. Sharing the game helps too, especially as we work toward streamer coverage, which is an essential step for releasing any game today.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with Greenhouse. We’re close.[/p]

notes.title: Visions Tell the Story
notes.content:
[p]In GREENHOUSE, the story unfolds through visions that you, the player, experience.

We’ve added a subtle vignette with vascular patterns around the edges of your field of view to make the visions feel more like they’re happening inside your mind rather than just on the screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45199226/f834984090832b303d34a26a79c9a6da09767a2b.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: GREENHOUSE DEMO @ EXCALIBER INDIE ASSEMBLE
notes.content: GREENHOUSE is a liminal psychological horror game set in a mysterious botanical space where your sixth sense reveals memories that tell the story. The horror stems from the unsettling atmosphere rather than gore or obvious threats, though you can enable entities and jumpscares to heighten the experience. As you progress, perspective puzzles will challenge your perception, adding complexity to the mystery while keeping you on edge.

notes.title: Thank you for the Feedback!
notes.content:
On behalf of 7D Games Studio and The Ground Keeper, a BIG thank you to everyone who provided feedback, play testers and content creators alike!

The feedback allowed us to know what worked well and what needed to improve.

Here is a summary of the changes we made to make the game great and enjoyable.

[h1]Improvements Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] Flashlight runs out of juice if left on, but batteries can be found to recharge
[*] Squeezed as many FPS as we could for the more graphic intensive scenes
[*] Made character take photos with phone instead of a flash on the screen
[*] Adjusted volume, spatiality and directionally of sounds
[*] Made pointing at objects easier to interact with them
[*] Added text labels to the UI (previously icons only)
[*] Made perspective puzzles easier to align
[*] Added skip for intro
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Too many to mention but over 300 bugs were fixed!
[/list]

Not insects were harmed during the making of this game.
